scope: Current source and mocked client interceptor tests; no live authentication, relay, session revocation or federation deployment.

tests.initial_attempt: npx failed before running tests with npm ENOSPC; direct installed runner succeeded.

findings: Server retains legacy session headers; current browser API interceptor signs NIP-98.
Nostr-prefixed invalid authentication returns an error before legacy fallback.
validate_session compares token and age against mutable last_seen; it does not itself refresh last_seen.
NIP-98 authority is verified event pubkey, not a delegated principal. Bridge verifies source signature and signs a new service event with source_event reference.
